maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes mainly from building and selling new homes to buyers; mortgage, title and insurance are smaller side services.

publicly_funded.reason: Homes are bought by consumers, funded by private mortgages and savings; some VA loans for veterans are minor.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by building and selling homes in its own communities, with only occasional builder acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Homebuyers choose among competing builders on price and location; once the home is bought, there is no ongoing switching cost.
